description: S3 Bucket with Effective Bucket-Level Public Exposure
rationale: The observed bucket policy or effective bucket ACL provides a public-access vector not suppressed by restrictive account/bucket controls. The rule uses GetBucketPolicyStatus, Bucket/Object Ownership, ACLs, and effective Block Public Access. It does not evaluate access points, object ACLs, IAM, endpoint policies or SCP/RCP layers.
remediation: Review policy public grants and ACLs; enable appropriate S3 Block Public Access settings and BucketOwnerEnforced where compatible. Independently verify access points and resource policies.
